theFirstExecutable: The smallest real vertical slice proving: minimal intent -> complete-enough understanding -> machine fact discovery -> only-necessary questions -> correct dependency-aware queues -> execution with already-available capabilities -> verification -> finished result OR exact human-only blocker.

acceptanceSteps.must: A user provides minimal project intent (one short sentence).
SI inspects the project, repos, prior decisions, installed agents/CLIs, local runtimes, deterministic tools, accounts, and credentials-by-reference.
SI produces an explicit model: known facts, unknown facts, contradictions, reversible assumptions, irreversible decisions, missing capabilities.
SI discovers every machine-discoverable fact BEFORE asking the user.
SI asks only for information/action it cannot safely obtain or infer.
SI compiles a dependency-correct project/lane graph and derives execution queues from intent+facts+acceptance+dependencies.
SI executes all runnable work using capabilities the user already has (no global key requirement).
A blocked lane does not stop unrelated runnable work.
SI verifies produced outputs and repairs failed verification.
A new user instruction triggers intent reconciliation + downstream impact analysis; invalidated work is removed; unaffected completed work is preserved.
SI continues until the verified product is complete OR genuine human action is the only remaining blocker; the same session resumes after human actions.
Platynum-47 exposes the truthful state of understanding, queues, lanes, artifacts, execution, verification, blockers, and final output (no fabricated percentages).
